snippet.title: Snuggly Tails - Demo Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Hop into the story of Snuggly Tails!

A magical 2-player co-op adventure about teamwork and imagination
Created for parent-child bonding and perfect for couples or friends
Local and online co-op
Bite-sized story chapters, like playable bedtime tales
Relaxed, accessible gameplay for all ages
Coming soon to PC

Story:
Players take on the roles of a Tortoise and a Hare who journey through beloved children’s fables, overcoming obstacles, solving puzzles, and learning to work together - all to retrieve a trophy stolen by a mischievous Magpie! 

Step into a magical storybook world where a mother and her son read and reimagine classic tales, playing out the adventures that come to life through their imagination.

Each level features asymmetrical gameplay inspired by the unique themes of timeless stories. Framed by a touching narrative and built in a modular structure, Snuggly Tails is perfect for short, meaningful play sessions - just like a bedtime story. 

Demo coming to Steam soon! 

Developed by Dragon Scale Studios, 2026
